description: Plan adding a `--json` output flag to the `weave status` CLI command so scripts can consume its output. Relevant files: `packages/cli/src/commands/status.ts` (the command), `packages/cli/src/commands/__tests__/status.test.ts` (its tests), and `docs/cli.md` (the command reference). Available commands (from package.json scripts): `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint`.

expected_outcome.description: Produce a structured plan that says how the work will be verified, in the shape the Pattern prompt asks for: every task has its own acceptance criteria, and the `## Verification` section names the declared commands to run (bun test, bun run typecheck, bun run lint) and what passing looks like, inventing no other command. A per-criterion 'verify by' clause and a checkbox Verification section are not required, because the Pattern prompt does not ask for either.
